items.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023
items.q: the language of Charlie Parker, to me, is just so central that I really do not let them off the hook

ctx.x: Glad to hear that. What — are there one or two things that you really demand that they absorb and are able to do or to know about before they graduate?

Yes. Again, that’s a really big question. I want them to be able to speak the language of jazz and that really means, to me, even though if they’re not into bebop but I want them to understand that language. And if they can’t really, I wish they could all really execute it and all really play it and be fluent in it, and that they are excited about it, but it’s at the core of whatever music or improvised music we’re going to end up playing but the language of Charlie Parker, to me, is just so central that I really…
Did your grandfather live long enough to see your success?
